'''2007 Dagobah Regionals Mitchell Hensley DS Cloud City Occupation''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Mitchell Hensley]] at [[2007 Dagobah Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Cloud City Occupation|SE-D-cloudcityoccupation.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Plz don't sand out
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
